title: ‘So Stupid’: Mads Pedersen Dumps on One of UCI’s Most Ridiculous Rules
content:
Cobblestone star blasts regulation that forces riders joining new teams to black out their new bikes before January 1. Better not ask his thoughts about sock height rules, then.

Read the full article at ‘So Stupid’: Mads Pedersen Dumps on One of UCI’s Most Ridiculous Rules on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
